title: 2018 School reunion for all HHS students
description: For the Town of Hartland’s 100th anniversary since incorporation, one of the most memorable festivities was its first-ever all-school reunion, welcoming teachers, students, and graduates of every generation. While no alumni from the original Hartland Superior School remained, hundreds returned from Hartland High and many more from the newer Hartland Community School, which hosted the event. Despite working with a shoestring budget, the organizing team spread the word through Facebook, flyers, and videos, reaching out to class presidents and key contacts from as far back as possible. On Saturday, August 4, 2018, more than 1,000 former students registered at the door. They searched for classmates in designated rooms, enjoyed entertainment in the cafetorium, including a fashion show and live music, and marvelled at memorabilia that filled the gym. Transportation was provided, photos were taken, and a kids’ zone was set up for families. The event surpassed all expectations and became a true celebration of community spirit and shared memories.
